an3.113:1.1: Tayo 'me bhikkhave āpāyikā nerayikā idam appahāya. Katame tayo? Yo ca abrahmacārī brahmacārīpaṭiñño, yo ca suddhaṃ brahmacāriṃ parisuddham brahmacariyaṃ carantaṃ amūlakena abrahmacariyena anuddhaṃseti, yo cāyaṃ evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi n' atthi kāmesu doso ti, so kāmesu pātavyataṃ āpajjati. Ime kho bhikkhave tayo āpāyikā nerayikā idam appahāyā ti.
